title: Daddy Puts Up a Picture
hook: 猪爸爸自己挂画，一锤子把墙敲出大裂缝，只好补墙刷漆，还弄了一屋子灰。

cells.q: What do Mummy and Daddy Pig have?
cells.a: They have a new picture of Peppa and George to put up.
cells.cn: 他们有一张佩奇和乔治的新画要挂起来。

cells.a: They asked if they can help put up the picture.
cells.cn: 他们问能不能帮忙挂画。

cells.q: What is Daddy Pig going to do?
cells.a: He is going to knock a nail into the wall.

cells.q: What did Peppa say about the wall?
cells.a: She said, “I can still see the crack, Daddy.”
cells.cn: 她说：“爸爸，我还看得见那条裂缝。”

cells.q: What did Daddy Pig worry about?
cells.a: He worried that Mummy Pig will notice the crack.
cells.cn: 他担心猪妈妈会发现墙上的裂缝。

cells.q: How does Daddy Pig mend the wall?
cells.a: First he fills the hole with bricks, then plaster and paint.
cells.cn: 他先拿砖填洞，再抹灰、刷漆。

cells.q: What did Peppa and George see?
cells.a: There is a big mess on the floor and the walls.
cells.cn: 地上和墙上弄得一团糟。

cells.q: What did Daddy Pig tell the children?
cells.a: He told them to pretend nothing has happened.
cells.cn: 他让孩子们假装什么都没发生。

cells.a: She said she thought they were going to put the picture up.
cells.cn: 她说她还以为他们要把画挂上去呢。

helper.order: First / Next / Then / After that / Finally
helper.keywords: picture, nail, wall, crack, hole, mess
helper.actions: put up, knock, mend, fill, paint, clean

opener: Today I watched Peppa Pig. This episode is “Daddy Puts Up a Picture”.
ending: In the end, the picture is still not on the wall. My favourite part is ______.
